name: The Anchor
fieldReading: Hold your ground, and others are free to lose theirs.
bio: The steady friend everyone drifts back to. Keeps their feet when the night tilts, and holds the spot where others can lose theirs.
sceneStory: A wide river of liquid light pours across the frame, sweeping loose stars and tumbling figures along in its current. Braced dead-center against the flow with boots planted and knees bent, a figure holds their ground while the rushing light splits into two smooth curves around them.
